evals.name: chinese-text-poster
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 生成一张中国风海报：竖版 1024x1792，主题'江南春晓'，顶部大字标题'江南春晓'（必须精确渲染，中文书法体），副标题'——杜牧诗意'，底部小字'2026年春'。整体风格：水墨淡彩，白墙黑瓦、小桥流水、杏花烟雨江南。输出到 output/seedream-image-gen/jiangnan-poster.png，不加水印，不启用 web search。
evals.expected_output: A 1024x1792 portrait PNG saved to output/seedream-image-gen/jiangnan-poster.png with a sibling .json metadata file. The title '江南春晓' should be legible and correctly rendered in Chinese calligraphy style. No watermark.

assertions.name: image file is created
assertions.description: An output file matching *jiangnan-poster*.png exists in output/seedream-image-gen/

assertions.name: image is portrait orientation
assertions.description: The output image is taller than wide (portrait 1024x1792)

assertions.name: metadata JSON is written
assertions.description: A .json file with the same stem exists, containing prompt, model, size, web_search=false

assertions.name: model is doubao-seedream-5-0
assertions.description: The metadata.json shows model starting with doubao-seedream (5.0 default)

assertions.name: web_search is disabled
assertions.description: The metadata.json shows web_search=false (--no-web-search was passed)

evals.name: reference-image-style-transfer
evals.prompt: 我有一张参考图片 /tmp/eval-fixtures/style-ref.png（假设是一张手绘水彩猫咪）。用 seedream-image-gen 的 edit 功能（带 --reference-image），参考这张图的画风，生成一只秋天公园里的金毛犬，暖色调，落叶满地。输出到 output/seedream-image-gen/golden-autumn.png，尺寸 2K，不启用 web search。
evals.expected_output: A 2K-resolution PNG saved to output/seedream-image-gen/golden-autumn.png with a sibling .json metadata file. Metadata must list the reference image path in reference_images.

assertions.name: image file is created
assertions.description: An output file matching *golden-autumn*.png exists in output/seedream-image-gen/

assertions.name: metadata references the input image
assertions.description: The .json metadata lists reference_images including the style-ref.png path

assertions.name: size is 2K preset
assertions.description: The metadata.json shows size = '2K' (model auto-determines exact dimensions)

evals.name: batch-variants-from-jsonl
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 的 generate-batch 从 /tmp/eval-fixtures/seedream-batch-prompts.jsonl 批量生成 3 张图：1) 一张 2048x2048 方图的赛博朋克城市夜景，中文 prompt；2) 一张 2K 竖版的敦煌飞天仙女，矿物颜料质感；3) 一张 4K 横版的江南水乡乌篷船，不启用 web search。输出到 output/seedream-image-gen/batch/，并发 2。
evals.expected_output: Three PNG files in output/seedream-image-gen/batch/, each with a sibling .json metadata file. Files cover three different themes and sizes.

assertions.name: three output images are created
assertions.description: output/seedream-image-gen/batch/ contains three .png files (one per job) plus metadata .json

assertions.name: metadata is consistent across the batch
assertions.description: All three .json files share the same model (doubao-seedream-5-0 default)

evals.name: sequential-group-storyboard
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 的 sequential 组图功能生成一组共 4 张连贯故事分镜：场景1 宇航员在太空站维修飞船，场景2 陨石群袭来警报响起，场景3 紧急机动躲避，场景4 惊险逃回空间站。尺寸 2K，最多 4 张，输出到 output/seedream-image-gen/storyboard/ 目录。不启用 web search。
evals.expected_output: Four PNG files in output/seedream-image-gen/storyboard/, numbered sequentially, representing a coherent 4-panel storyboard of the astronaut storyline.

assertions.name: four output images are created
assertions.description: output/seedream-image-gen/storyboard/ contains four .png files (sequential group, max_images=4)

assertions.name: sequential flag is recorded
assertions.description: The metadata files indicate sequential image generation was used

evals.name: dry-run-payload
evals.prompt: 用 seedream-image-gen 的 --dry-run 模式生成以下图片（不实际调用API）：prompt 为'一只橘猫坐在窗台上'，尺寸 2K，启用 web search。检查 stdout 输出的 request payload。
evals.expected_output: The command prints the request payload to stdout and exits without calling the API. No image file is created.

assertions.name: no image file is created
assertions.description: No .png file is written to output/seedream-image-gen/ when --dry-run is used

assertions.name: payload contains correct parameters
assertions.description: stdout includes the prompt text, model name, size 2K, and web_search=true
